audit_items.proof_trace: The property holds via two layered protections: (1) `flash_loan_withdraw` (reserve.move:318-324) does not update `self.cash`, so a flash loan borrow leaves `util_rate = debt/(debt+cash-cash_reserve)` unchanged; (2) in `handle_mint` (market.move:274), `accrue_interest` is called before `deposit_underlying` increases `self.cash`, so depositing flash-loan proceeds during the same tx cannot retroactively lower the interest rate captured at accrual time. The `last_updated == now` guard (reserve.move:132-135) ensures subsequent `accrue_interest` calls in the same timestamp are no-ops, preventing any same-tx manipulation.
